title: In This Valley Time Runs SLOWER the Higher You Are
description:
In this valley, time runs slower the higher up you are. Grandads live in the attic, and if you're waiting for a parcel, you sit in the cellar.

I'm the lookout, 112 stairs up on the highest ridge. For one week, my brother and I made a deal: at ten every night, I flash my lamp and he flashes back. His window answered. Then it never went dark.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: In this valley, which floor would you live on, and who would you take up there with you?
